about_the_game:
In the shadowy alleys beneath Hong Kong’s aging tenement buildings, the scent of curry fishballs lingers in the air. You are Yu Sang , a woman working at a local street food stall. As night falls, the streets grow eerily silent. One by one, the regulars leave—until it’s just you... and her—a customer from another world.

"HONG KONG HAUNTING: FISHBALL GIRL"  is a first-person simulation game where you run a traditional Hong Kong street food stall, selling iconic snacks to survive. But something strange is happening. Unexplainable events begin to unfold—until finally, you’re forced to face her.

Combining urban legends with gritty Hong Kong culture, you’ll explore narrow alleys, fog-shrouded markets, and a buried truth the creator never meant for you to find. Each fishball you serve may be a clue to the city's hidden horrors. Every footstep behind you... might not belong to the living.

 Key Features:

  • Urban Hong Kong Horror: Inspired by real-life Hong Kong ghost stories, blending familiar night markets with an uncanny atmosphere.

  • Psychological Narrative: A non-linear story with player-driven choices. Can you uncover the truth? There are more than 1X possible endings.

  • Immersive Interactions: Every action and line of dialogue may hold a clue—or a trap.

  • Realistic Hong Kong Aesthetics: Faithfully recreated 80s–90s Hong Kong street scenes with high-detail visuals.

  • Fishball Simulation: Experience life as a street food vendor. Cook, serve, survive.

Are you ready to serve a special guest from the other side?
